regime.name: Synoptic S-SE-SW (Xaloc / Migjorn / Llebeig)
regime.why: 11-16 h mean 14.3 kt from 249°; 07-10 h 19.0 kt from 264°

days.headline: Synoptic S-SE-SW (Xaloc / Migjorn / Llebeig): 14 kt avg from WSW (249°) 11-16 h, oscillating. Favoured: right. Confidence low.
interpretation: Synoptic southerly: onshore, steady direction (AROME dir MAE 8° historically), AROME historically over-forecasts by ~2 kt at the buoy.
Land-sea contrast: inland max 24.2 °C vs sea 19.6 °C (ΔT +4.6 °C); morning offshore component 0.0 kt → sea-breeze potential good.
Over the water: air +2.0 °C vs sea → stable (air warmer than sea). Expect smoother but layered wind; gusts weaker than AROME may show.
Front/instability warning: MSL pressure change 08→18 h -0.8 hPa, AROME gust factor 1.63.

History (Synoptic S-SE-SW (Xaloc / Migjorn / Llebeig) (all speeds; fewer than 8 buoy days in the 10-15 kt band), 112 days, Oct-Mar since 2022-11): buoy averaged 10.23 kt (q25-q75 5.55-13.97, n=19) when AROME said 7.79 kt (median of all 112 days). LEPA airport averaged 9.22 kt (n=112). Direction 11→15 h at the buoy: veer 60% / back 30% / steady 10% (n=10).

strategy.text: AROME is steady (≤15° over the race window). Climatology for this regime at the buoy: shift std 5.9°, peak-to-peak 13.4°, cycle ~46 min. Tack on headers vs the median heading.
strategy.history_bias: History leans VEER: 60% of analog days veered >5° 11→15 h, 30% backed.
strategy.side_text: Favoured side: RIGHT. Onshore synoptic wind with fetch: chop builds, little geographic shift except near the shore. (inference)
strategy.start: Check line bias with transits several times; in a persistent shift start at the end nearer the new wind, even if it is slightly unfavoured. In oscillations, start where you can tack onto the lifted tack freely.
strategy.windward_mark: Expected drift to the right (history lean, oscillating): approach on the tack that keeps you inside the shift, and tack short of the layline (it moves).

why: AROME HD vs AROME France 11-16 h: mean |Δspeed| 1.8 kt, |Δdir| 8°
front/instability flags (pressure change ≥3 hPa or AROME gust factor ≥1.6)
AROME HD historical error in this regime at the buoy (Oct-Mar 11-16 h): MAE 2.9 kt, bias +2.0 kt, dir MAE 8.0° (n=64)

expected_observed.text: AROME 11-16 h mean 14.3 kt × historical ratio of buoy-observed to AROME-Portals (q25 1.02, median 1.19, q75 1.34, n=19 days). Hourly AROME range 9.8-19.3 kt. This is open-bay (SOCIB buoy) wind; inshore Portals usually reads lighter.

analogs.label: Synoptic S-SE-SW (Xaloc / Migjorn / Llebeig) (all speeds; fewer than 8 buoy days in the 10-15 kt band)

notes: Runner (burda): Gold Cup notes say mostly ~45-60 % of the scale; ease in lulls/chop, max in the top of the range.
Rake used at the Gold Cup: 122.5 (max loose), 122.0, 121.5 (windiest days).
Gold Cup shroud extremes: max tight 20 V / 12 D, max loose 14-15 V / 7-8 D.
Top of range is in North's V-6M/V-6H overlap (14-18 kt): decide on trend and sea state.

regime.name: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral)
regime.why: 11-16 h mean 15.5 kt from 313°; 07-10 h 19.3 kt from 260°

days.headline: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral): 16 kt avg from NW (313°) 11-16 h, persistent back (left). Favoured: left. Confidence low.
interpretation: Offshore northerly: gusty and shifty near shore, flatter water close in; expect the wind to ease or back late if the gradient weakens (watch AROME trend).
Land-sea contrast: inland max 20.7 °C vs sea 19.5 °C (ΔT +1.2 °C); morning offshore component 3.0 kt → sea-breeze potential poor.
Over the water: air +0.8 °C vs sea → near-neutral.
Front/instability warning: MSL pressure change 08→18 h 6.4 hPa, AROME gust factor 1.58.

History (Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral) (all speeds; fewer than 8 buoy days in the 15-20 kt band), 104 days, Oct-Mar since 2022-11): buoy averaged 11.86 kt (q25-q75 9.58-13.36, n=20) when AROME said 8.05 kt (median of all 104 days). LEPA airport averaged 11.05 kt (n=104). Direction 11→15 h at the buoy: veer 50% / back 33% / steady 17% (n=6).

strategy.text: AROME trends 23° left (back) from 11 to 16 h: play it as persistent, sail the headed tack first toward the new wind, don't overstand.
strategy.history_bias: History leans VEER: 50% of analog days veered >5° 11→15 h, 33% backed.
strategy.side_text: Favoured side: LEFT. Offshore wind: puffs come off the Serra/Na Burgesa valleys in streaks; look upwind for dark patches, expect more pressure and bigger shifts nearer the shore. (inference)
strategy.start: Check line bias with transits several times; in a persistent shift start at the end nearer the new wind, even if it is slightly unfavoured. In oscillations, start where you can tack onto the lifted tack freely.
strategy.windward_mark: Expected drift to the left (persistent): approach on the tack that keeps you inside the shift, and tack short of the layline (it moves).
